report.summary: All four failures are the same flaky timeout: GET /books (and the register redirect that lands on it) calls list_books, which sleeps a random 0-8 seconds, while the UI fixtures allow only 5 seconds. Fix the app's random sleep in app/main.py:150 first, since that is the root cause; the tests themselves are correct and no test changes are needed.

causes.title: Random 0-8 s delay in list_books makes /books loads exceed the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database. Every render of /books goes through it (books_page -> render_books -> list_books, app/main.py:250-256). The UI conftest sets page.set_default_timeout(5000) (tests/ui/conftest.py:7), so any page load that draws a delay above about 5 s fails. The chance of that is roughly 3/8 per load. The three tests that failed on page.goto('/books') hit that path directly. test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf failed on the Register click, because the click waits for the post-submit redirect to /books, and that redirect renders the same slow page. The outcome depends on random timing, so the same code can pass on a rerun. This is not a product_bug in the sense of deterministic wrong behaviour, but the injected delay is clearly not intended behaviour. The sleep is the underlying cause and should be removed or made configurable (for example, disabled when a test env var is set). If it is meant to stay as a load-simulation feature, the UI tests need a timeout that covers 8 s plus render time.
evidence: app/main.py:149-150: def list_books(user_id: int) -> list[dict]: / time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
app/main.py:250-256: render_books(...) builds "books": list_books(user["id"]) on every /books render
tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7: "Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s" / page.set_default_timeout(5000)
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py failure: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63002/books", waiting until "load"
tests/ui/test_login_ui.py failure: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. ... click action done / waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (register submit redirects to /books)
tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:31 test_books_page_requires_login does not render /books and is not among the failures, which fits the random delay being the trigger
grep for sleep|random in app/ and tests/: only app/main.py:150 (app delay) and tests/conftest.py:41 (0.2 s poll in server start-up)
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) from list_books in app/main.py, or gate it behind an environment variable that is off in CI. Then rerun the UI suite. Do not raise the 5 s default timeout in the tests just to hide the delay. If the delay is needed to simulate a slow backend, use a fixed, deterministic value and give the affected tests an explicit longer timeout.
